title: Michael Jackson ONE by Cirque du Soleil® VIP Experience
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Children under 18 must be accompanied by an adult
Single seating can be purchased, but there is a limit of 4 tickets sold per performance.
You must arrive at the theater at least 50 minutes prior to showtime
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Elevate your night with the ultimate Michael Jackson ONE VIP Experience in Las Vegas. Enjoy exclusive VIP access, including a pre-show reception, a behind-the-scenes virtual tour of the theatre, and a meet & greet with cast members. Then, settle into premium VIP seats for the unforgettable Cirque du Soleil performance, an electrifying fusion of dance, acrobatics, and stunning visuals set to Michael Jackson's iconic music. Immerse yourself in the magic like never before.
